name: Figure II-5: carrying capacity vs vision and metabolism
description: Figure II-5: carrying capacity (mean population over ticks 200–300, after it has settled) against mean vision, one line per mean metabolism, starting from 500 agents under ({G₁}, {M}). A mean of m is the uniform range 1–(2m−1). Seeds 1–10; the book averages 10 runs per point. Measured (release, seeds 1–10): metabolism 1 mean population 438.7 at vision 1 and 485.9 at vision 6; metabolism 2 mean population 281.6 at vision 1 and 316.8 at vision 6; metabolism 3 mean population 191.0 at vision 1 and 250.1 at vision 6. Ticks 300, 500 and 1000 all satisfy the settlement rule for every cell; 300 is the smallest.
